what: HIGH (code audit CA-A05-006, MEASURED 2026-09-27): src/units/strategies/htf_pullback_trend_2h.py's module docstring states the unit is a "SCAFFOLD, not wired" and "inert until the Tier-3 activation PR" -- but it is the live implementation behind 19 enabled strategies in config/strategies.yaml (16 execution:live, 3 shadow), one of which (the base BTC 2h leg) traded real money on bybit_2 for ~3 months (promoted 2026-06-02, demoted to shadow only 2026-08-23 after losses, OOS net_R -13.933). src/runtime/intent_multiplexer.py:258 dispatches htf_pullback_trend_2h_signal_builder; strategy_signal_builders.py:1412 calls the unit's order_package(). The same file elsewhere admits "19 ENABLED legs the intent multiplexer routes to this module" -- directly contradicting its own opening line. This is a docs-vs-code drift finding (docstring says inert, code/config say live), not a new logic bug -- the risk is a future session trusting the docstring and treating changes to this file as low-risk/scaffold-only when they in fact touch a live real-money-eligible order path. FIX: rewrite the opening docstring to state current reality (live-wired since 2026-06-02); add a CI guard failing when a strategy docstring contains "not wired"/"SCAFFOLD"/"inert" while config/strategies.yaml has an enabled block pointing at it. Full finding: docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A05.findings.jsonl id CA-A05-006.
